lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: The Powercut. It is evening. Peppa and George are in the sitting room, dancing to their favourite song. Daddy Pig is in the hallway, vacuuming the carpet, and Mummy Pig is in her study, doing important work on her computer.
lines.zh: 停电了。傍晚时分。佩奇和乔治在客厅里，跟着他们最喜欢的歌跳舞。猪爸爸在过道里用吸尘器吸地毯，猪妈妈在书房里用电脑处理重要的工作。

lines.en: Oh! Oh! Mummy, Daddy, it's gone all dark, and the music has broken! And my vacuum won't work! And my computer has switched off!
lines.zh: 啊！啊！妈妈，爸爸，到处都黑了，音乐也停了！我的吸尘器也用不了了！我的电脑也关机了！

lines.en: Hmm, Mummy Pig tries the light switch, but the lights do not come on. It must be a powercut! What's a powercut? A powercut is when there is no electricity. What's electricity?
lines.zh: 嗯，猪妈妈试了试电灯开关，可灯就是不亮。一定是停电了！什么是停电？停电就是没有电了。那电是什么？

lines.en: Electricity is what makes everything in our house work. Will the electricity come back again? Yes, but in the meantime, we need to find a torch! I think there's a torch in the cellar. Okay, I'll go and get it! Will you be okay, Daddy?
lines.zh: 电就是让我们家里所有东西运转起来的东西。电还会回来吗？会的，不过在那之前，我们得先找一支手电筒！我想地窖里有一支手电筒。好吧，我去拿！爸爸，你没事吧？

lines.en: I'll be fine, I can see very well in the dark!
lines.zh: 我没事的，我在黑暗里看得可清楚了！

lines.en: Who put that there? Oof! Daddy, are you okay? Yes, it's just a bit dark down here!
lines.zh: 是谁把那个放在这儿的？哎哟！爸爸，你没事吧？没事，就是下面有点黑！

lines.en: Oh, I just remembered, I think the torch is in the kitchen!
lines.zh: 哦，我想起来了，手电筒好像在厨房里！

lines.en: Aha! Mummy Pig has found the torch! Can I hold the torch, Mummy? Okay! George, look at me! Peppa is making a funny face!
lines.zh: 啊哈！猪妈妈找到手电筒了！妈妈，我能拿手电筒吗？可以！乔治，看我！佩奇在做鬼脸！

lines.en: Don't worry, George, it's only Peppa!
lines.zh: 别怕，乔治，那只是佩奇！

lines.en: Oh, we'd better tell Daddy we found the torch! Daddy is still in the cellar, looking for the torch. I'm sure it's here somewhere! Where?
lines.zh: 哦，我们最好告诉爸爸我们找到手电筒了！爸爸还在地窖里找手电筒呢。我肯定它就在这儿的什么地方！在哪儿？

lines.en: Daddy, we found the torch! Luckily, it was in the kitchen all the time! What a stroke of luck!
lines.zh: 爸爸，我们找到手电筒啦！幸好，它一直都在厨房里！真是运气好！

lines.en: Now we just have to wait until the electricity comes back. How long will that be, exactly? Um, I would say... exactly a long time!
lines.zh: 现在我们只要等电回来就行啦。具体要等多久呢？嗯，我会说……具体是很长一段时间！

lines.en: Oh, but George and I want to do some dancing! I know what we can do! We can watch some television! Oh, it won't go on! The TV needs electricity, too! Does it? Yes!
lines.zh: 哦，可我和乔治想跳舞呢！我知道我们能做什么了！我们可以看电视！哦，电视打不开！电视也需要电呀！是吗？是的！

lines.en: Oh, now what are we going to do? In the olden days, when there was no television, children would have to make up their own games! Hmm, I know! I need a cardboard box! What is Peppa doing?
lines.zh: 哦，那我们现在该怎么办呢？在很久以前，还没有电视的时候，孩子们得自己编游戏玩！嗯，我有办法了！我需要一个纸箱！佩奇在做什么呢？

lines.en: Mummy, will you cut a hole in this box for me? What for? You'll see! Mummy Pig is cutting a hole in the cardboard box.
lines.zh: 妈妈，你能帮我在这个箱子上剪个洞吗？做什么用？你等着瞧吧！猪妈妈正在纸箱上剪一个洞。

lines.en: There you are, Peppa! Thank you! Now you all have to sit down there, and George, you have to point this torch at me!
lines.zh: 给你，佩奇！谢谢！现在你们都得坐在那儿，乔治，你要把手电筒照着我！

lines.en: Welcome to Peppa Pig News, with me, Peppa Pig! Peppa has made her own television!
lines.zh: 欢迎收看小猪佩奇新闻，我是主持人小猪佩奇！佩奇自己做了一台电视机！

lines.en: Today, the whole world stopped working when there was a powercut, and all the electricity was lost! Very good, Peppa! Daddy Pig says that the electricity won't be back for a long, long time!
lines.zh: 今天，因为停电，整个世界都停止运转了，所有的电都没有了！非常好，佩奇！猪爸爸说电要好久好久才会回来！

lines.en: Oh! The electricity is back! Hooray! Hooray! Shush! I haven't finished yet! Switch the lights off! Okay, Peppa!
lines.zh: 哦！电回来了！太好啦！太好啦！嘘！我还没讲完呢！把灯关掉！好的，佩奇！

lines.en: Good. Hmm, I have some very important news! The queen has just found some more electricity, and says that everyone can now be happy again! Very good, Peppa! Hooray!
lines.zh: 很好。嗯，我有一条非常重要的新闻！女王刚刚又找到了一些电，她说现在大家都可以重新开心起来了！非常好，佩奇！太好啦！

lines.en: Peppa quite enjoyed the powercut, but she's happy the electricity is back again!
lines.zh: 佩奇还挺喜欢这次停电的，不过电回来了她也很开心！
